search_semantics.drug: Matches the intervention name or derived intervention MeSH term: filter.advanced (AREA[InterventionName]"<drug>" OR AREA[InterventionMeshTerm]"<drug>") matches the listed intervention names (with the API's concept expansion of aliases) or the study-level intervention MeSH terms, not titles or descriptions.
